methods.warm_rebuilds: Seven alternating/rotating nix-build --check runs per mode and selection. Tools, downloads and layer preparation already realized. Includes evaluation, assembly, NAR checking and daemon overhead. Package-content caching and retained stores disabled. All 63 checks passed.
methods.ordinary_source_updates: Seven alternating/rotating ordinary nix-build runs per mode on copied CI exports after changing a source marker. Layers stay cached. The new marker is checked in every result; original exports are unchanged.
methods.initial_preparation: Three alternating builds per mode, forcing distinct derivations with an inert nonce. Tools and downloads remain cached, but the installed layer is rebuilt for each layered trial. No network time included.
methods.assembler_only: Seven alternating runs on identical selected CI sources. Direct mode reads the same realized archives; attachment reads an already-built layer. Output cleanup and all Nix overhead excluded.
methods.input_closures: Realized assembly input outputs plus runtime references, excluding the compiler used to build the helper. Fresh local file binary caches, zstd level 3. Counts all closure bytes, not just the final derivation.
methods.host_prefetch: Actual archive file lengths for every locked full-Vue package compared with the exported x86_64-linux target closure. All 741 immutable archives were present and measured. Excludes HTTP overhead; this is a byte count, not network timing.
methods.compression: Three alternating publications of the same final CI output and full runtime closure into fresh local file caches at zstd levels 3, 9 and 19. Measures compressed bytes and local wall time, not remote transfer latency.
methods.parity: Exact file digests, executable bits, directories and symlink targets for all three selections. Normalize only generated bin/metadata absolute roots. Outputs retain only self references; no package bytes moved into another runtime output.

validation.scope: Nix package/flake checks; all native integration, fetch, registry, CI, incremental cache, platform and pinned Vue tests. Layer tests cover source and bin changes, new directories, workspace cycles, patches, input mismatch rejection, retained/external stores, zstd, pnpm parity, reproducibility and no hidden layer runtime reference. CI layer and zero-registry reactivity layer independently verified with offline pnpm. Native SWC, Rollup, Parcel watcher and unrs-resolver runtime checks.
